mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_feedback_source(public_id,source_channel,source_record_id,app_version,source_event_time, fault_occurred_at,fault_time_raw,fault_time_precision,fault_time_source,fault_time_resolution, source_update_time,ingest_time) VALUES(#{publicId},'STATION_FEEDBACK',#{sourceRecordId},#{appVersion},#{sourceEventTime},#{faultOccurredAt}, #{faultTimeRaw},#{faultTimePrecision},#{faultTimeSource},#{faultTimeResolution},#{sourceUpdateTime},#{ingestTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
